en: Black‑and‑white view of a grand spa-resort complex in a narrow valley backed by dense forested hills. The foreground shows a long, ornate colonnade or pavilion with domed roof sections; behind it stand several large, multi‑storey neoclassical and belle‑époque style hotel buildings with many windows and balconies. A tall chimney emits smoke, and on the wooded hillside above is a solitary monument or lookout. The overall layout and architecture suggest a European spa town from the early 20th century.
